production_review: The complete Engine and worker edits retain both parents. Raw current words and fresh PCM determine SpokenTurn; held carried answers use spoken=None and return before Unclear. The misheard note participates in Prepared::misfit. Scope, offer identity, expiry, private news, IPC retry guards and shutdown remain intact.
memory_path: The installed requested_audio_runner reaches the shared Memory runner. DaysClient adds the same-person conversation source_ids and days_protocol forwards them to remember_from; no Music context is sent to Memory. All changed Memory runtime files match the integration parent.
limits: Private composition; final publication follows actual Bedtime landing.
Engine simulation covers authorization and event ordering, not live STT, physical hums, acoustic onset, or device playback.
The upstream stale-source-after-forget P2 is assigned to the Memory owner and is not fixed here.
Warm-STT pause/split, held-report scoped context, and speaking-face findings remain separately owned; unmerged fixes are not imported.
